assets.caption: EXHIBIT 10-59 Arrangements for Level Instruments — a. Single-Mounted Level Controller. Plan and elevation views of a level controller (right hand) mounted to a tower with a cover swing area indicated. Elevation shows the level controller bridle with two side connections sized 1 1/2" or 2"ø, mounted to the tower over a platform, with a 3/4" drain at the bottom. Vertical center-to-center distance between bridle taps noted as 3'-6" to 6'-7" (200 to 2000).

EXHIBIT 10-59 Arrangements for Level Instruments — b. Single-Mounted Level Gauge and Switch. Plan and elevation views of a level gauge and a level switch mounted to a tower. Elevation shows a vertical bridle assembly with 1 1/2" vent at top, GLASS section, 1/2" drain, 3/4" drain, and 1"ø connection to a level switch on the side; bridle is mounted to the tower over a platform.
